$comment: P2-B/P2-C regression ratchet, recorded from a measurement and never hand-tuned. `kernel_to_feature_file_edges` is the number workbook section 16 must drive to ZERO ('foundation -> building implementation edges = 0'); until it is zero this artifact is the floor that stops it silently growing back. Lowering a value here is the whole point of the migration and is done in the same commit that lowers it; raising one requires a recorded reason, because the alternative reading of a rise is a new inversion.
ownership_model: config/capability-modules.json -- the OWNERSHIP MAP, not the manifests
why_the_model_is_named: The manifests declare 25 module paths and therefore see 3 capability edges; the ownership map owns 596 files (plus 2 composition-root files) and sees 801 cross-capability file edges. Every number below is meaningless without saying which model produced it, and the legacy `architecture:ratchet` -- which reads the manifests -- cannot see any of these edges at all. That is why this ratchet exists beside it rather than inside it.
measured_cycles_by: node scripts/phase2-cycles.cjs (read by this ratchet, not recomputed here)
reason: Lowered from 82 to 73 by the provider closure extraction (see docs/city/PHASE2_P2A_PROVIDER_CLOSURE.md): the provider types moved out of src/shared/contracts.ts -- owned by `status` -- into src/shared/provider-contracts.ts, owned by `providers`, and the 30 importers were re-pointed. `providers -> status` fell from 13 edges to 3, and the mutual-pair count was checked BEFORE the move because the two shared modules could have formed a cycle and raised it; it was already a mutual pair, so it stayed at 38. `files_owned` rose from 597 to 598 because the new module is owned rather than unowned. The largest surviving inversion is now `persistence -> tenx` (11), which is one directory, electron/commander/**, attributed to `tenx` although its contents are a task ledger, a budget manager, a context manager and a recovery scheduler.

anti_gaming.files_owned_is_a_floor: A drop in edges that comes from a drop in SCANNED FILES is not progress. `files_owned` is asserted to stay at or above its recorded value, so a file cannot be removed from the scanner -- or handed to the composition-root class to make it invisible -- to make the migration look finished.
anti_gaming.capabilities_with_kinds_is_pinned: `kernel` is read from the manifests' `kind` field, so a kernel that lost its kind would silently stop being counted. The kind count is pinned so that cannot happen quietly.
anti_gaming.the_composition_root_must_stay_visible: The composition root is present and its edges are counted separately. If it were removed from the map instead of re-attributed, `files_owned` would fall; if it were re-attributed back to `runtime`, `kernel_to_feature_file_edges` would jump by about 72.
anti_gaming.the_cycle_graph_has_floors: `largest_scc_size` is a CEILING -- section 17's target is 0 and a large component does not split from pairwise repairs -- but the GRAPH it is computed over has FLOORS (`capability_nodes`, `capability_edges`). Shrinking the largest component by losing an edge from the measurement is the same fraud as shrinking the inversion count by scanning fewer files, and it would be invisible from the component size alone.
anti_gaming.the_two_cycle_count_is_measured_twice: `mutual_capability_pairs` is asserted from BOTH the inventory's pair rollup and the cycle instrument's own edge list. If the two instruments ever disagree, both problems fire: a number nobody can reproduce is worse than a number that is wrong.
